title: PJTSAU Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Various Field Assistant I Posts
description: Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University (PJTSAU) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies for 01 Field Assistant I position. Interested and eligible candidates can apply for this post before the last date. Candidates who have completed their Diploma in Agriculture Polytechnic can apply for the PJTSAU Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can attend the walk-in interview. Here, we have mentioned the education details, age limit, selection process...
